_comment: Tier-2 for dune::time_dependent_heat#0, #2, #3 and #4 — one heat problem, u_t = kappa Laplace(u) on [0,1]^2 with u(x,0) = sin(pi x) sin(pi y) and u=0 on the boundary, and only TWO compiled forms (backward Euler and Crank-Nicolson) because dt and kappa are dune.ufl.Constants. Wall time 421 s on 2026-08-06, dune-fem 2.12.0.2, dominated by the two 640-step reference runs. Measured: marching with u_n updated takes max(u) from 1.000000 to 0.906890, while leaving u_n at the initial condition leaves it at 0.980644 — the run repeats its first step. Per-step cost over 40 steps varied by 1.08x around the tail mean, so the scheme reuses its assembled operator. Temporal orders: BE 4.323124e-04, 2.158010e-04, 1.065227e-04, 5.162473e-05 -> 1.045; CN 1.452362e-06, 3.628501e-07, 9.064549e-08, 2.259711e-08 -> 2.004. At 1000x the explicit CFL step (1.953125e+01 against 1.953125e-02) backward Euler stayed finite and decayed to 1.058414e-08. IMPORTANT METHOD NOTE: the orders are measured against a FULLY DISCRETE reference (the same scheme at dt/128), not against the analytic solution. Measured on this grid the analytic route puts a spatial error floor at about 2.8e-05 which Crank-Nicolson reaches by dt = T/5, and its observed order then came out 0.000 — the study was measuring the SPACE error. Anyone re-tuning this fixture should keep the discrete reference. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 measures the "CN" column with the BACKWARD-EULER scheme, which is exactly pitfall time_dependent_heat#3 -- Crank-Nicolson written with the implicit-Euler factor. Both schemes are already compiled, so the mutation costs no rebuild. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'crank_nicolson_is_second_order=True', 'implicit_euler_factor_costs_an_order=True', 'dune_time_stepping_traps_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
